analyzed_vuln.description: In URLParser::parse, `processed_input` is a StringView that is reassigned to a temporary `String` (`processed_input_string`) after tab/newline stripping (lines ~211-217). The code does `processed_input = processed_input_string;` then leaves the scope, destroying `processed_input_string` and freeing its StringImpl. `processed_input` becomes a dangling view, but is then used to build `Utf8View input(processed_input)` and iterated, causing a heap-use-after-free in Utf8CodePointIterator::operator*(). Root cause is lifetime mismanagement in URLParser::parse (storing a view to freed temporary), not Utf8View itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when URLParser::parse takes input containing `\t` or `\n` so the replacement branch executes. FuzzURL passes attacker-controlled bytes directly as StringView into URL(string_view) -> URLParser::parse. In that branch, replacements allocate a new String, then a dangling StringView is kept after temporary destruction; subsequent UTF-8 iteration over `processed_input` dereferences freed memory and crashes.
